killedBy: the versus map cards (issue #274) says what a board supports, not what is currently selected
why: Reads the selection instead of the catalog, which makes every card agree with the count already chosen -- true of the moment and useless for the choice the line exists to inform. The row is filtered to eligible boards, so the number is never WRONG; a player at two players sees "2 players" on Pinwheel, which is two-only, and on Arena 1, which is 2/3/4, and cannot tell that changing the count would keep one and drop the other. Every card still renders with a plausible line, which is why the case that kills this compares two boards with DIFFERENT declared support in one fixture rather than asserting a format.
